shortDescription: According to ChainCatcher citing The Defiant, decentralized finance protocol Sky’s total value locked fell 15% in one week. Over the same period, the circulating supply of Sky-issued stablecoin USDS declined to $5.59 billion. Sky.money shows the governance-set savings rate at 3.8%.
